question: This is the as-found single-line diagram of a building's 480 V switchgear. A crew must work on BUS 2B (panel PNL-2B). It must be isolated: afterwards there may be no path through closed breakers from any source (utility services, generator G1, or the PV-1 solar inverter, which can feed power back) to BUS 2B. Breakers that are already open need no action. Open as few breakers as possible, and do not cut power to any running load that is not fed from BUS 2B. Which breakers must be opened? Answer with the breaker IDs sorted alphabetically, separated by commas.
references: IEEE Std 141 (Red Book), secondary-selective / main-tie-main low-voltage switchgear single-line diagrams
IEEE Std 315 / ANSI Y32.2 graphic symbols and ANSI/IEEE C37.2 device numbers (52 = AC circuit breaker)
